setup.title: Set up your platform
setup.subtitle: A few short steps. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.

language.title: Choose your language
language.help: This sets the language of the admin. Each site you create chooses its own language separately.

account.title: Create the administrator account
account.noticeBody: This account can manage every site, plugin and setting on this installation. Use an email address you control.

platform.title: Name your platform
platform.name: Platform name
platform.nameHelp: Shown across the admin. Leave it empty to keep the default name.
platform.timezoneHelp: Used whenever the admin shows a date. Pre-filled from this browser — change it if the platform runs elsewhere.

errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match

database.title: Where should this platform keep its data?
database.help: Asked first because nothing else can be stored until it is answered. This is the one choice here that cannot be changed later in Settings.
database.restartWarning: Choosing this restarts the platform so it can connect. It takes about twenty seconds, and this page waits for it. The passwords are generated for you and stored on the server — you never have to type them.
database.claimedByOther: Someone else reached this installation first and is setting it up. If that was not you, restart the platform to start again.
database.failed: The database could not be configured. Please try again.
database.restartTimeout: The platform is taking longer than expected to restart. Your database settings were saved — reload this page to continue.

postgres.name: PostgreSQL
postgres.note: Recommended. Runs one site or many, keeping each site's data separate at the database level.

sqlite.name: SQLite
sqlite.note: One file, no database server to run. Not available yet: parts of the database setup are written for PostgreSQL only, so an installation on it would not finish starting. It will also only ever serve a single site — it has no way to keep two sites' data apart.

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.note: Shipped but not finished: no backups and no test coverage yet, so it cannot be chosen here. It will also be single-site until it can separate sites' data.

domain.title: The admin's domain
domain.adminUrlHelp: Prefilled with whatever you are using right now — a bare IP is fine until DNS is ready. This is what the platform routes the admin by, so change it only if you will reach it somewhere else, and point that domain here first.
domain.unclaimedWarning: This installation has not been claimed yet. Until you finish, anyone who can reach it can set it up instead of you. It stops accepting setup 15 minutes after starting.
